text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on streaming.sse in eu-west-1 (>3s). Paging rotation triggered.
oncall-eng: I'm on it, acked the page. pulling up dashboards now.
maya: seeing proxy queue length up, write latency spiking on the edge proxy. client slow-consumer signals climbing.
raj: any upstream 5xxs?
maya: some 504s from upstream, but most are stalls/long tails, not full failures. retransmits visible in tcp_summary.
samira: starting quick mitigations from runbook: enabling per-route backpressure throttle and lowering proxy send buffer. doing in canary first.
eng-runtime: recommend reducing batch window to 5ms for streaming routes and enabling an autoserve fallback to smaller model variant for high-latency flows.
ops-sre: noted ALB logs show increased keepalive timeouts. we can reduce keepalive and dial down connection pooling to free slots.
oncall-eng: samira, apply canary then roll to 50% if clean. notify when p95/p99 move.
samira: canary toggle applied. command: `kubectl patch svc streaming-proxy -p '{"spec":{"backpressure":true}}'` - canary pods updated.
maya: metrics update: p99 dropped from ~3.2s -> 1.1s on canary subset, overall still 1.9s. client reconnects dropping.
raj: good. next step: enable proxy-level throttling globally for the route and shorten keepalive to 30s. ops-sre ok?
ops-sre: ok executing keepalive change on ALB and proxy pool scale.
eng-runtime: also enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts (low-risk) — should shave off tail tokens.
samira: global throttle flipped. monitoring dashboards.
maya: customer-impact: ~1.2% of EU streaming sessions experienced stalls/reconnects during spike window, started at 09:12 UTC. major customers degraded but not fully blocked.
oncall-eng: escalate to incident lead if not back to SLO in 15m. tagging #infra-briefing. :eyes:
ops-sre: keepalive + throttle + reduced batch window applied. p95 ~ 320ms, p99 ~ 720ms now. tail still occasional at ~1.3s.
eng-runtime: recommend follow-up: a) investigate client-side backpressure signals b) tune proxy write batching heuristics c) longer-term: dynamic routing to lower-latency variants under tail pressure.
samira: leaving mitigations in place. will roll back canaries gradually after stable for 30m.
maya: collecting logs for RCA, will annotate traces with session ids and sample payloads.
oncall-eng: thanks team — I'll keep oncall rotation posted. documenting timeline in incident tracker. :thumbsup:
ops-sre: watching, will open postmortem draft and include mitigation checklist.
eng-runtime: if customer reports persist, we can flip fallback policy earlier. ping me.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied; watch period started 09:27 UTC. If latency rises above p99 1.5s escalate immediately.
